summary: Comprehensive testing of Unified Reference Number System completed. Backend: 14/15 tests passed (1 skipped - no vendor matched RFQs). Frontend: All reference number displays verified across Admin Dashboard (RFQs, Quotes, Orders tabs), Buyer Dashboard, Vendor Dashboard, BuyerOrders, VendorOrders, OrderDetail, BuyerRFQList, VendorQuotes, BuyerQuotes, and RFQDetail pages. Copy-to-clipboard functionality works (Check icon appears after click). Search by reference number works on Admin Dashboard.

minor.issue: RFQ response model was missing rfq_number field - FIXED by adding Optional[str] rfq_number to RFQ model

critical_code_review_comments: get_next_sequence() function correctly uses MongoDB findOneAndUpdate with upsert for atomic sequential number generation
RFQ model now includes rfq_number: Optional[str] = None field for proper response serialization
RefNumber component correctly implements copy-to-clipboard with Check icon feedback
All dashboards (Admin, Buyer, Vendor) properly display reference numbers with copy icons
Search functionality on Admin Dashboard correctly filters by reference numbers
Order inheritance chain verified: order_number, rfq_number, quotation_number, item_name all properly inherited
seed_data_creation: Used existing migrated data - 217 RFQs, 71 quotes, 50 orders with reference numbers
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reference number system fully implemented and tested. Key formats: RFQ-YYYY-XXXXX, QT-YYYY-XXXXX, ORD-YYYY-XXXXX. MongoDB counters collection stores sequence state. RefNumber component at /app/frontend/src/components/RefNumber.jsx provides copy-to-clipboard with visual feedback. All frontend pages updated to display reference numbers instead of internal IDs.
